steps.label: POS_TRANSACTIONS_PIPE
steps.sub: Snowpipe auto-ingests into RAW.POS_TRANSACTIONS_RAW, no schedule

code:
CREATE PIPE PINEHURST_DB.RAW.POS_TRANSACTIONS_PIPE
  AUTO_INGEST = TRUE
  AZURE_NOTIFICATION_INTEGRATION = 'pinehurst_blob_event_notify'
AS
  COPY INTO PINEHURST_DB.RAW.POS_TRANSACTIONS_RAW
  FROM @PINEHURST_DB.RAW.STG_POS_EXPORTS
  FILE_FORMAT = (FORMAT_NAME = PINEHURST_DB.RAW.FF_POS_CSV);
caption: AUTO_INGEST = TRUE is the whole point -- no batch window, just an event.
Zero error rows on a test file is the bar before calling this production-ready.
